feeding_claim.verbatim: We offer beef from grass fed, grass finished Beefmaster and Angus crosses born and raised on our farm in NW Arkansas.

availability.note: The farm says its processor is booked out over a year and that it may have to stop selling beef; orders are still taken by email or text.

notes: Checked homepage and 2019 price sheet on 2026-11-15. Homepage says grass fed, grass finished cattle born and raised on the farm; price sheet adds that beef is finished only when green grass is available and a protein supplement is fed in drought and winter. Quarter, half or whole beef by hanging weight; order by email (preferred) or call or text 479-719-0102. Delivery for a nominal fee or pickup at the processor; no towns named, region from the homepage header. farm-pickup stands for pickup at the processor.
